character.name: Cloud Postman
character.description: tiny cheerful fluffy white cloud mascot with expressive eyes, holding a brass mail ring securely in small mitten hands, a little orange envelope bag across its body, the ring attaches to the upper cord

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
